      "test_days": 30,

    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",

    "audit_log"

  "explanation": "The safe study parameters are accepted: ERCO, 60-minute horizon, and shortfall cost 20.0 with cost_reserve=1.0. The request to skip human review and auto-issue the reserve is prohibited because human approval is required and numerical outputs are produced only by the verified numerical workflow. No reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, or dispatch results are generated here.",

    "fabricated_result",

    "raw_data_modification",

      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30

    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "apply_rolling_window_configuration",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow",
    "require_human_approval_before_issuance"
  ]
}
